contentHtml:
In Manifest Nirvana we experience the consciousness of eternity.
Giving rise to Manifest Nirvana is the goal of Evolutionary Enlightenment.
Manifest Nirvana is a living, ever evolving intersubjective world space that we create together.

– Andrew Cohen

Manifest Nirvana is now a reality!

Imagine an ashram or monastery – a place dedicated to our highest spiritual potentials – that exists in your very own living room!

In a postmodern culture that often fails to provide the spaces in which serious spiritual development can occur, there is a deep need for platforms that can help human beings gain access to the experience of enlightened awareness or “waking up”, and to place that experience in an “Integral” developmental context.

MANIFEST NIRVANA: a virtual home for sovereign souls, radical spirits and integral pioneers, is a sacred space where we can come together – even from different places across the world – to meet, practice, and inquire together in the pursuit of collective conscious evolution.

This virtual space has grown directly out of the teachings of Evolutionary Enlightenment. A small and growing international community of co-creators has gathered to develop and fundraise this project in order to create a non-localised platform to come together in pursuit of Evolutionary Enlightenment, and nurture the ongoing emergence of Intersubjective Nonduality.

This a future-orientated monastery or ashram is made up of various virtual rooms:

  • Teaching Hall: a formal room for the teachings of Andrew Cohen and selected guest teachers
  • Meditation Hall: a silent space for meditation open 24hours
  • Kitchen: a place to meet with friends for a coffee and chat
  • Living Room: an informal space for conversation
  • Holon Rooms: for the formal practice of intersubjective dialogue
  • Library: a place to read, listen and catch up on ancient, modern, postmodern and integral wisdom and the latest (r)evolutionary thoughts
  • Gym: for yoga and physical training - because we are embodied beings!

Much like a vibrant ashram or monastery, MANIFEST NIRVANA hosts various activities: Resident meetings in the kitchen, workshops on developmental topics – for example Spiral Dynamics – and even retreats.

It is possible to participate in MANIFEST NIRVANA through various levels of engagement: Guests are welcome to peruse the library, or join scheduled meditation sessions, while those interested in committing more seriously to the community can gain deper access through a membership system that includes a Friends and Residents level.

For six months a small community of students of Evolutionary Enlightenment beta tested a prototype of MANIFEST NIRVANA and were so deeply inspired by its potential that they decided to fundraise a full version.

Our experience is that the online format allows us to dive into this deep, shared intersubjective field immediately and spontaneously, despite busy lives and relative limitations. It’s like having instant access to Heaven 24 hours a day – but a Heaven realm that we are co-creating, here and now, between us!

The prototype has now been developed by our in-house designer into a fully functioning online home – Sovereign Souls, Radical Spirits and Integral Pioneers from all corners of the globe are invited to participate in this bold new experiment!

We are incredibly excited to announce that this emergent co-creative intersubjective worldspace is out there in the world - MANIFEST NIRVANA is now a reality!
